title: Mobile Wallet Shortfall Re-Credit Remedy: Customer Hand-Over Card
content:
**Mobile Wallet** — the customer's choice to have a short credit made good by a re-credit to the same wallet.

## Situation and business effect
On an incorrect-amount error notice that Paloma has found in the customer's favour (a decision of error found), the customer may choose to have the missing amount re-credited to the same wallet. The tool `choose_shortfall_recredit_f54302ef` records that choice and sends the re-credit. Its effect, as the tool itself defines it:

- the choice is recorded against the notice (remedy `recredit_shortfall`, dated today);
- the whole principal Paloma holds for the transfer is sent at once to the transfer's wallet as a new credit attempt, at the rate and local amount given;
- the principal Paloma holds drops to 0.00, and the transfer moves to processing with its release moment set to now and its date available set to today;
- the customer can tell the recipient the re-credit is on its way.

## Conditions
The amount a shortfall re-credit delivers is fixed only after Paloma's own shortfall credit stands on the transfer's ledger.

A shortfall re-credit is not sent to a wallet until no earlier-booked transfer of the same customer addressed to that wallet number stands with a failed credit.

Restated: while Paloma's own shortfall credit is not yet on the transfer's ledger, the amount the re-credit would deliver is not settled; and while any transfer of the same customer booked before this one and addressed to the same wallet number still stands with a failed credit, the shortfall re-credit does not go to that wallet.

## How it is invoked
The choice is the customer's own. The agent unlocks `choose_shortfall_recredit_f54302ef` and hands it over, and the customer themselves runs it; the agent reads the references from the Mobile Wallet lookups and passes them, with the quoted rate and amount, to the customer.

## Parameters

| Parameter | What it is | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `wallet_transfer_id` | the reference number of the Mobile Wallet transfer the remedy is for, as the agent reads it from the Mobile Wallet transfer lookup | identifier |
| `related_case_id` | the reference number of the error notice the choice answers, as the agent reads it from the Mobile Wallet case lookup | identifier |
| `credit_attempt` | the number of the re-credit attempt on the transfer, one more than the credits already sent on the transfer | integer count starting at 1 |
| `fx_rate_applied` | the exchange rate the re-credit converts at, as the agent quotes it | payout-currency units per 1 USD, 4 decimal places |
| `receive_amount` | the amount the re-credit delivers to the wallet, as the agent quotes it | payout currency, 2 decimal places |

## Return
A dictionary rendered as text with `case_id` (reference of the recorded choice), `remedy_choice` (`recredit_shortfall`), `ledger_entry_id` (reference of the re-credit entry), `credit_attempt`, `amount_usd` (USD sent, 2 decimals), `fx_rate_applied` (4 decimals), `receive_amount` (payout currency, 2 decimals) and `status` (now processing). A receipt with both references and status processing means the choice is recorded and the re-credit went out.
